## docs:api:en truncates l10n/docs.api.pot without docs:api:css

data.content:
The CI drift is real. Your local check passed because it was reading an out-of-date generated page, and I've now reproduced the failure locally.

**Why the results differ:**
- CI runs `gate:i18n`, which rebuilds the English API pages, including `docs/api/css/**` via `docs:api:css`, before it checks for drift.
- `i18n:check:drift:all` reads whatever `docs/api/css/*.md` already exists. It doesn't regenerate those pages ([vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts#L561-L581)).
- Commit `4bef12dae` (`feat(button-set): add -width-half modifier`, 12:14 today) changed `plugins/pantoken/custom-components/.../button-set.css`. Your local `docs/api/css/button-set.md` was generated at 10:06, before that commit, and had no `width-half` entries. The local check compared translations against the old page, so it found nothing.

**Reproduced locally:** I ran `vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:api:css` and then `vp run i18n:check:drift:all`. It fails the same way CI does: 215 units in `docs/api/css/button-set.md`, across 43 locales. The regeneration also updated `l10n/docs.api.pot`, which now shows as modified.

**To fix it:**
1. Fill in the translations: `vp run docs:locales:translate` (CI suggests this command), or the `:agy` variant if your `claude` login has expired.
2. Run `vp run i18n:check:drift:all` again to confirm it's clean.
3. Commit the updated `l10n/docs.api.pot` along with the new `l10n/*/docs.api.po` translations.

To match CI locally in future, run `vp run gate:i18n`, or run `docs:api:css` before the drift check. I haven't run the translation step because it calls an AI provider. I've also added this to the repo memory notes.
